# CRM Competition & Differentiation

| Competitive layer | Representative direction | Industry implication |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Global enterprise suites | Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, SAP Sales Cloud and Salesforce are embedding agents in CRM workflows. | Do not compete on a generic AI assistant; focus on a clearly bounded operating workflow. |
| China CRM platforms | Chinese vendors increasingly combine lead, opportunity, CPQ and sales-agent capabilities. | Local process fit, delivery speed and integration evidence are required. |
| Specialist tools | Email automation, prospecting, CPQ, ERP and finance tools solve individual steps. | An integrated data chain can reduce tool fragmentation when the scope is controlled. |
| Industry capability | Industry process understanding + AI execution + quote/order/collection loop + cross-border controls. | Workflow depth, auditability, reusable templates and ecosystem integration are increasingly important. |
